public_config_change: Two unconditional fields: CompressOutput in prior padding, CompressMinBytes appended. Config520 to528 on both measured x64 hosts; old field offsets unchanged. This is a checked-Size/binary ABI change, including ConfigInit storage. Rebuild ALL consumers against matching headers/libraries; not a drop-in old binary replacement.
contract: Default output compression is off; default threshold256. With an explicit output policy AND actual negotiation, compress whole Text documents at/above the threshold; retain uncompressed reference-send semantics otherwise.

Core RFC7692 handles offers/responses, both direction/window/context facts, RSV1, compressed data, UTF8, control/continuation and native encoded output. Client/server enable/require/decline and bounded nonblocking server policy callbacks reuse existing config. Borrow callback code/data through retirement.

Clamp native decoded output to RPC MaxMessageBytes, keeping configured lower native caps. Keep native frame/send and RPC receive/output bounds separate. Raw message length does not wrongly reject a valid compressed frame that fits permanent native capacity.

Borrow the retained Duplex document during synchronous compression; Core owns encoded bytes after acceptance. Started remains the first offer, even if refused. AGAIN never replays an accepted document; optional dictionary discard on refusal can reduce ratio.

Copy negotiated facts/policy under the existing gate; reject pending queries without modifying output and keep facts after physical native stream release. Publish handoff facts before dropping the real old HTTP owner.
resource_accounting: Measured config520 to528, info680 unchanged and old RequestContext/AllowBinary offsets504/496 preserved on both x64 hosts. Public layout is constant across feature selections. Readiness occupies existing reference-field alignment padding: HTTP peer private1568 Windows/1776 WSL Linux with or without compression selected.

Native WS private1064 to1080 Windows and1200 to1216 WSL Linux when Core compression is selected:16 bytes for codec pointers. Codec objects, lazy dictionaries, encoded output, CPU, scans and transformations are additional and not zero overhead. No performance acceptance is inferred.

Parse contiguous TCP headers through const spans. Never cast a native borrowed TCP receive buffer to mutable Pullup: IOCP can own an active write reservation. Partial TCP/cross-block heads and exceptional TLS prefixes use the existing bounded16KiB cold cache; consume precisely through CRLFCRLF and preserve the coalesced WS suffix. Count preview/header copies and erase/free cold storage.

Actual original budget1 at the public native compression offer produces typed MEMORY with conservative Started delivery, no business execution, zero live charged bytes/count and actual native/host joins. Scope is one real refusal and existing Core OOM/bound regressions, not exhaustive asynchronous fault coverage.
